summary: Full-stack testing of Cruciverba Insieme (Italian real-time crossword). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed (create room, join, second player color, room full 403, unknown room 404, cell set/state propagation, invalid cell 400, focus, new puzzle, empty-name 400, no solution leaked). Frontend: Two-browser real-time flow verified end-to-end: P1 creates a room (used fallback pool, generated in <5s), P2 joins via code, presence shows both names, letter typed by P1 (Z) appears on P2 within ~2s via polling, letter typed by P2 (Q) appears on P1, spacebar toggles Orizzontale/Verticale (banner switched from '3 Oriz.' to '1 Vert.'), clicking an across clue selects the corresponding word and updates the active-clue banner, share button clickable, home/presence/grid all render. Design looks polished (paper texture, serif typography, terracotta accents), contrast is fine. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py join_room: existing player match is case-insensitive but does not verify that the requester is truly the same person; anyone who knows a room code AND the other player's name can hijack that player_id. Acceptable for MVP with no auth, but worth noting.
server.py: no cleanup of stale rooms; MongoDB collection will grow unbounded. Consider TTL index on created_at.
Game.jsx polling every 1200ms works but WebSocket would be more efficient for true real-time; current pending-buffer merge (2500ms) handles the propagation window well.
crossword.py build_from_fallback recursion depth is fine but attempts=40 with 22 words is CPU heavy; acceptable.
No rate limiting on /rooms create or /cell endpoints — could be spammed.
public_puzzle strips 'answer'/'solution' correctly — verified no leakage.
test_credentials: No auth; ephemeral room codes generated at runtime (used BFEJ during test)
seed_data_creation: None; test creates its own rooms and P2 tries a 3rd-player join which is expected to 403
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_rooms.py covers all 6 endpoints. LLM word generation may take up to 60s when the Anthropic key is used; tests still pass because fallback pool kicks in. Frontend real-time verified with two browser contexts using tab-crea then tab-unisci + code-input. Grid keyboard input goes to a hidden input; clicking anywhere on the grid focuses it. Space toggles direction; Backspace clears. Victory overlay was NOT explicitly triggered (would require solving the puzzle) but win detection is unit-covered on the backend (all(entries==solution) → status='completed') and the frontend renders overlay conditionally on status==='completed' with data-testid=new-puzzle-button.
